rules: Re-read current root-session config at execution; preserve model/provider/budgets; record both variants.
Use a new SQLite database and workspace for each variant/case/repeat; never use current app database/workspace.
No real patient data. Sample medical/legal citations are unverified, not ground truth.
Count every scheduled run including provider errors; label injected reviewer failures separately.
Approval must not trigger implementation. Do not call Execute during this quality benchmark.
No live call until scripts/eval/guard.py accepts explicit opt-in and a user-specified USD budget.
